# Credits {.unnumbered}

The chapter list was constructed by surveying 12
publicly-available syllabi from major US biostatistics
programs (documented in `docs/syllabi-survey.md`) and
adopting the topics that appeared in three or more of them.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the Python script
at `images/build-cover.py`. Watercolor palette: deep
umber through warm bronze and ochre to warm amber and
pale cream, anchored on the brand ochre `#a06a1f`.
Typography: Avenir family (Apple system font); body text
in Source Serif 4.
